Tests benzathine penicillin for secondary prophylaxis and the no-aspirin rule for chorea — key prescribing traps
Tests application of modified Duke Criteria for IE diagnosis — the diagnostic framework required by competency
Tests the critical rule of blood cultures before antibiotics in IE — the most important and commonly violated action

Tests the first-line management approach for paediatric hypertension — lifestyle versus pharmacotherapy
Tests the systematic CVS examination technique in children — the IPPA sequence and murmur characterisation
Tests age-specific vital sign interpretation — heart rate and blood pressure norms change with age in children
